official_endpoint_document_set.aggregate_algorithm: sha256(sorted newline records: url byte_length raw_markdown_sha256)
official_endpoint_document_set.note: HiBob publishes one Markdown-wrapped OpenAPI fragment per endpoint. The packs omit a misleading partial openapi_source; this fixture retains each official raw page hash and extracted OpenAPI hash.

official_inbound_webhooks.note: These official post_webhook_* pages describe inbound payloads and are intentionally not emitted as outbound operations.

transport.auth: HTTP Basic with a HiBob API service-user ID and token; credentials remain connection-owned.

contract_gaps.split_openapi_fragments: Each official endpoint page embeds only its own path plus module webhooks/components. No single official fetchable OpenAPI document covers the complete outbound surface.
contract_gaps.inbound_webhooks: 28 post_webhook_* pages describe payloads HiBob sends to consumers. They are not outbound HTTP operations and are intentionally not emitted as callable pack operations.
contract_gaps.permission_omissions: HiBob may return 200 while silently omitting employee fields outside the service user permission set. Workflows state this and do not interpret absence as an empty vendor.
contract_gaps.people_search_scope: POST /people/search has no pagination and may return every accessible employee. The shipped directory requests six explicit fields and active employees only.
contract_gaps.nested_body_pagination: Four searches accept pagination only as a nested body.pagination object. The top-level REST body projection cannot inject a nested continuation cursor, so those operations expose the documented object for explicit page calls and do not claim an automatic walker.
contract_gaps.complex_request_schemas: The composition request-schema validator closes scalar-only argument maps. Array/object operations retain an explicit manifest arg allowlist and their documented nested schemas, while the request_schema remains open because closed complex properties are not supported by that validator.
contract_gaps.multipart_uploads: Three direct binary document upload routes are excluded; the three JSON URL-upload alternatives are admitted.
contract_gaps.source_eligibility: No Source is declared without a mandatory version signal in the official task or attendance-project response contract.
